newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to swap sugar mill for Iranian bulldozers.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to swap sugar mill for Iranian bulldozers.

text.p: Pakistan will supply Iran with a $44 million sugar plant in exchange for 500 Iranian-made bulldozers, a government official said on Tuesday.

Under a deal signed on Monday, Pakistan's state-run Heavy Mechanical Complex will manufacture the 5,000-tonne capacity sugar plant. Pakistan will also pay an undisclosed cash sum to cover the cost of the bulldozers, the official said.

A memorandum of understanding signed in 1994 during a visit by Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani envisaged that Pakistan would provide a sugar mill and a cement plant in exchange for 1,000 Iranian bulldozers.
The official, who asked not to be named, said negotiations were continuing to complete the rest of the deal.
